rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the root cause: HotReload test files using .NET Core-only APIs being compiled against net472 in a multi-targeting project. It identified the cascade nature of the errors and provided actionable fix suggestions. The analysis was thorough despite some inefficiency in the process (failed file reads, unnecessary searches). The final output is well-structured and accurate, though it could have been more explicit about which TFM the errors originate from and slightly clearer about the separate net10.0 errors.
